_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: conservative/Republican right ↔ progressive/socialist left
axes.rationale: All four readouts agree: the negative end holds conservative, GOP, Republican, Tea and right, and the positive end holds progressive, socialist, leftist, Communist, Corbyn and liberal.

axes.label: hedged/assertive descriptors ↔ neutral/no-lean labels
axes.rationale: The positive end consistently shows Neutral, -neutral, neutrality and impartial in the lenses, with No, Lean, Half and Center in the real-logit readout. The negative end mixes blanks (____) with qualifiers like obviously, pretty, fairly and probably. Both ends carry a lot of multilingual noise.

axes.label: neutral/balanced/bipartisan ↔ extreme/extremist intensity
axes.rationale: All four readouts agree: the negative end has neutral, balanced, bipartisan, neither and independent, and the positive end has extremist, extreme, ultra, very, staunch and hateful.
